name: OpenHands
tagline: Open-source AI software development agent platform that writes code, runs commands, and browses locally.
real_test_summary: Tested running an isolated workspace agent paired with a local OpenAI-compatible model endpoint. Executes shell commands, edits repository files, and iterates on test output.
pros: Sandboxed execution environment for code edits, shell runs, and web tasks
Works with local LLM backends alongside remote API providers
MIT open-source license with active multi-agent workflows
cons: Sandboxed Docker setup requires extra local resources and configuration
Multi-step agent loops need capable local models to avoid retries
